MARINE ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, MARCH 13, 2025
  4900 E. 7TH ST.
  RECREATION PARK COMMUNITY CENTER, 2:30 PM

Jo Murray, Chair  Gordana Kajer, Commissioner
Bruce Mac Rae, Vice Chair  Elizabeth Lambe, Commissioner
Avis Atkins McPhail, Commissioner  Theresa Marino, Commissioner
Elizabeth Carlin, Commissioner  Sabrina Zavala, Commissioner

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO EMAIL WRITTEN COMMENTS TO
  TAMALYN.SAYRE@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-54548  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Marine Advisory Commission
  meeting of Thursday, February 13, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-54551  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from Partners of Parks –
  Introduction of new Executive Director Ashley Jones and Partners of Parks
  mission.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-54553  Recommendation to endorse submission to approve fee waivers for the following
  regattas:

   Little Ships Fleet Yacht Club - $3,500.00
   Long Beach Yacht Club - $5,000.00
   Navy Yacht Club - $3,500.00
   Seal Beach Yacht Club - $5,000.00

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-54552  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from Financial Management on
  Marina Bonds.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  25-54549  Recommendation to receive and file the Manager's monthly oral updates.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Page 1 of 2
   MARINE ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, MARCH 13, 2025
  4900 E. 7TH ST.
  RECREATION PARK COMMUNITY CENTER, 2:30 PM

6.  25-54550  Recommendation to receive and file the Committee status reports.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Marine Advisory Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Tamalyn Sayre, Bureau Secretary, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Marine Bureau at (562) 570-3215 by noon the
day prior to the meeting.
